finding: Supported raw improvement taxonomy vs gate-admissible priority families

raw_diagnoser_confidences.lexical_repetition: medium when local_cluster_detected, else low (low -> monitored)
raw_diagnoser_confidences.connective_use: medium when specific boundary exists, else low
raw_diagnoser_confidences.sentence_structure_candidate: always low -> always monitored; cannot be selected as a student-facing priority
raw_diagnoser_confidences.input_quality: flag confidence (medium/high); flags input problems, not a realistic target issue

consequence: With the current production gate, generated priority families are effectively limited to lexical_repetition and connective_use. sentence_structure_candidate and input_quality cannot produce a student-facing priority without a production change (which D0 must not make).
sources: app/calibration/service.py (low-confidence signals are monitored, never selected)
app/feedback/validation.py (priority_feedback must reference gate-selected diagnosis ids)
audit_use: Corpus families preregistered around the gate-admissible families; sentence_structure_candidate is included as a preregistered probe with expected no-priority outcome.
